sections.section_title: UCPD Rx ordered set extension register 1 (UCPD_RX_ORDEXTR1)
sections.text_helper: Section 75.8.13 "UCPD Rx ordered set extension register 1 (UCPD_RX_ORDEXTR1)" in chapter 75 (USB Type-C®/USB Power Delivery interface (UCPD)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3969.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x034
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Writing to this register is only effective when the peripheral is disabled (UCPDEN=0).
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:0 RXSOPX1[19:0]: Ordered set 1 received
The bitfield contains a full 20-bit sequence received, consisting of four K-codes, each of five
bits. The bit 0 (bit 0 of K-code1) is receive first, the bit 19 (bit 4 of K-code4) last.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
